pb-straight-punch.description: Straight-body upper punches for accessible bends. Specify the punch angle, tip radius, working height and tang profile together with the lower die.
pb-straight-punch.process: The straight body transfers load to the punch tip. Check part clearance and the lower-die opening; the punch angle alone does not determine the finished bend angle.

dimensions.label: Punch angle and tip radius
dimensions.detail: Specify the tool angle and tip radius separately from the finished part angle and radius.

dimensions.label: Working height and tang
dimensions.detail: Dimension the load-bearing shoulder, tool height and complete clamping profile.

dimensions.label: Working length and sections
dimensions.detail: Provide total bend length, segment lengths and any horn or end-clearance requirements.

pb-straight-punch.compatibility: Match the punch tang and load-bearing shoulders to the holder. Check the complete bend sequence for interference.
inspection: Check tip profile, working height and segment alignment.
Confirm permissible load for the actual punch and lower-die combination.

pb-gooseneck-punch.description: Relieved upper punches for parts with return flanges. The gooseneck opening provides clearance while the tip forms the bend over a separate lower die.
pb-gooseneck-punch.process: Select the relief from the part cross-section and bending sequence. A larger throat changes the punch section and permissible load; check both clearance and strength.

dimensions.label: Gooseneck opening and clearance
dimensions.detail: Provide flange heights, return lengths and the part position at each bend.

dimensions.label: Punch angle and tip radius
dimensions.detail: Specify the working angle, tip radius and the required finished section.

dimensions.label: Working height and tang
dimensions.detail: Check tool height, holder interface and seating shoulders before replacement.

pb-gooseneck-punch.compatibility: Check the part against the punch, holder and machine throughout the bend sequence, including removal of the finished part.
inspection: Check the complete relief contour and tip position.
Confirm load limits for the selected throat and working length.

pb-radius-tooling.description: Radius punches and cylindrical inserts for large-radius bends. Select the insert, holder and lower-die opening as a complete forming arrangement.
pb-radius-tooling.process: The rounded upper tool forms the sheet across a suitable lower die. Target part radius and tool radius are separate inputs because springback and contact conditions affect the result.

dimensions.label: Part radius and tool radius
dimensions.detail: Provide the target inside radius, material and thickness; identify the existing insert radius separately.

dimensions.label: Insert and holder interface
dimensions.detail: Specify the insert diameter or profile, retention features and holder height.

dimensions.label: Lower-die opening and angle
dimensions.detail: Confirm the lower-tool opening, shoulder radii and clearance for the intended bend.

pb-radius-tooling.compatibility: Check the insert-to-holder fit and the complete upper/lower tool arrangement. Confirm the process with the actual material.
inspection: Inspect the continuous radius surface and insert seating.
Check the formed radius and springback through an agreed trial-bend procedure.

pb-u-forming.description: Matched tools for U-shaped sections. The inner width, flange height, bottom shape and release direction define the punch and lower-tool cavity.
pb-u-forming.process: A forming punch enters the matching lower cavity. Rounded and flat-bottom channels require different profiles; check wall clearance, material thickness and part removal.

dimensions.label: Channel inner width and flanges
dimensions.detail: Provide the complete finished section, inner width and both flange heights.

dimensions.label: Bottom profile and sheet thickness
dimensions.detail: Identify a flat or rounded bottom, corner radii and material thickness.

dimensions.label: Release direction and working length
dimensions.detail: Show how the part leaves the tool, including any ejector or support requirement.

pb-u-forming.compatibility: Check machine open height, stroke, tool shut height and unloading clearance against the proposed forming arrangement.
inspection: Check the matched profiles and material clearance.
Inspect channel width, flange geometry and corner shape on the trial part.

pb-embossing.name: Profile Forming and Embossing Tooling
pb-embossing.description: Matched punches and dies for custom pressed sheet sections. Provide the finished profile, forming depth, sheet thickness and release direction.
pb-embossing.process: The tool outline follows the required part section. Contact surfaces, forming travel, material flow and springback are assessed together for the specified operation.

dimensions.label: Finished profile and forming depth
dimensions.detail: Provide the section outline, depth, corner radii and reference surfaces.

dimensions.label: Material and forming operation
dimensions.detail: Identify the material, thickness and whether the operation forms a profile, bead or coined feature.

dimensions.label: Tool closure and part release
dimensions.detail: Confirm tool shut height, working travel and release or ejection direction.

pb-embossing.compatibility: Define the specific forming operation before tooling design. Confirm required force and machine travel with the proposed tool set.
inspection: Compare upper and lower contact profiles with the approved part section.
Confirm feature depth, position and surface condition on a trial part.

pb-container.name: Container Panel Forming Tooling
pb-container.description: Custom tooling for container-panel corrugations and edge sections. The panel drawing determines the profile, pitch, depth and forming sequence.
pb-container.process: Panel tooling is matched to the specified rib or edge section. Repeated corrugations require controlled pitch and sheet positioning; the tool arrangement depends on the actual panel.

dimensions.label: Panel profile, pitch and depth
dimensions.detail: Provide the complete corrugation or edge section, pitch, depth and corner radii.

dimensions.label: Sheet thickness and forming length
dimensions.detail: Identify material grade, thickness, panel width and working length.

dimensions.label: Feed direction and forming sequence
dimensions.detail: Show positioning references, feed steps and how the formed panel is supported and removed.

pb-container.compatibility: Check the actual panel drawing, forming sequence and machine capacity. A container component name alone does not define a tool profile.
inspection: Check profile continuity and repeated pitch where applicable.
Verify section depth and panel positioning on an agreed trial component.

pb-light-pole.description: Long tooling sets for polygonal or round pole shells. Select the section, taper, forming sequence and unloading clearance for the press brake arrangement.
pb-light-pole.process: Longitudinal bends form the pole shell. Tooling and bend sequence must accommodate the small-end section, large-end section and removal of the formed shell.

dimensions.label: End sections and taper
dimensions.detail: Provide small-end and large-end sections, length, taper and seam position.

dimensions.label: Forming method and lower tool
dimensions.detail: Identify polygonal bending or radius forming and the required upper/lower tool profiles.

dimensions.label: Machine span and working length
dimensions.detail: Supply machine working length, open height, stroke and any tandem-machine arrangement.

pb-light-pole.compatibility: Check holder interfaces, segment alignment, machine span and part removal across the complete shell-forming sequence.
inspection: Check tool alignment along the working length.
Inspect both end sections, taper and seam opening on the formed shell.

pb-quick-clamps.description: Upper-tool clamps secure the punch tang to the ram or an intermediate holder. Select the mounting seat, tang interface, seating and retention arrangement.
pb-quick-clamps.process: The clamping mechanism holds and seats the upper tool. The mounting side and punch side must both match; confirm how the punch is loaded, secured and released.

dimensions.label: Ram or holder mounting seat
dimensions.detail: Dimension the machine-side seat, mounting holes, bolt spacing and locating surfaces.

dimensions.label: Punch tang and support shoulders
dimensions.detail: Provide the complete tang section, seating shoulders and working-height requirements.

dimensions.label: Clamp mechanism and retention
dimensions.detail: Identify the lever or actuation arrangement, loading direction and required retention features.

pb-quick-clamps.compatibility: Confirm both machine-side and punch-side interfaces. Automatic alignment or fall prevention depends on the selected clamp design.
inspection: Inspect mounting datums, seating faces and clamp movement.
Verify tool retention and release using the selected machine and holder procedure.
